decisionsTitle: Race results, part 4: a race's own age categories, the podium for the awards, and the finish line «Sosire»
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-24, from the phone:** «I need to be able to create sex and age group categories for winners in order to give awards.» The ranking already placed every finisher by sex and by category (§808), but the category was one fixed table — the statistics' bands of §787, ten years wide from eighteen — and the podium had to be read off the whole sheet.

**Decision, the categories.** A category stays what §808 made it, the sex and an age band on the race's day; what a race may now choose is **where its bands start**: `events.result_age_bands` (migration `0178`, an expand — one nullable jsonb column), an ascending list of one to twelve ages between 1 and 99, read through `results/domain/age-bands.ts#ageBandStartsOf`. Null is the platform's bands, `DEFAULT_AGE_BAND_STARTS` = `[18, 30, 40, 50, 60]`, so every race that exists ranks exactly as before and the stored keys (`FEMALE:from30`, `MALE:under18`) keep their shape — a key says only where a band begins, and its end is read from the race's list, so the same `from30` reads «30-39 ani» under the platform's bands and «30-44 ani» where the next band starts at 45 (`bandLabelOf`). The catalogue's six fixed band words became three sentences with placeholders («sub {age} ani», «{from}-{to} ani», «{from}+ ani»), filled per band; the statistics' footer fills them from the platform's list and reads as it did. The box «Categorii de vârstă» sits on «Clasament», a form of its own (`setResultAgeBands`): whoever enters results may set it (the Organizer too), the list is read in any order and sorted, an empty box forgets the choice (null, never a copy of the default), a box that cannot be read is refused in place naming the problem (`RESULTS_AGE_BANDS`), and a change **ranks the stored results again in the same transaction** and tells the public cache, so a place by category never describes a band the race no longer has. One audit row, `event_results.categories_changed`, carries the ages and how many rows moved, never a runner. The public read carries the race's bands (`PublicEventResults.ageBandStarts`), so the event page, the CSV and the filter's chips say each category in the race's own words; the chips sort by the age a band starts at, whatever the bands.

**Decision, the podium.** «Premii», a card on «Clasament» (`results/domain/awards.ts#awardsOf`, pure): women then men, each sex's overall podium first — the ranking's own position by sex — then its categories youngest band first, the first three places in each (`AWARD_PLACES`), a tie on the same step, a group with nobody placed left out. Each line is the number, the name as the backoffice sees it and the gun time; nothing is counted again here and nothing is stored. The card is for the organizers at the ceremony; the public page is unchanged, since each public row already carries its place in its category.

**The owner, 2026-10-25:** «For this contest we just award top 5 men and top 5 women.» So the podium's depth and whether the categories are awarded are the race's own: `events.award_places` (1–10, three by default, a check at the database) and `events.award_categories` (on by default), migration `0179`, an expand; set on the «Premii» card itself by whoever enters results (`setResultAwards`, one audit row `event_results.awards_changed` with the two values), read by that card alone — the ranking knows nothing of them, and the public page shows every place as before. Unticked, the card lists the overall podium by sex and no category.

**Refused.** Named categories typed by the club (`M35`, `Veterani`): the sex and the start age say the same with nothing to translate and nothing to keep consistent between two languages. A category by sex alone or by age alone: the positions by sex exist already, and an age-only podium would mix the two sexes the club awards apart. A per-category depth (five overall, three in a category): one number is what a club race announces. Carrying the bands with a duplicate, a repeat or the JSON file: the next race decides its own categories, as it decides its results (§808's rule for `results_published`). Changing the Excel's «Statistici» to each event's bands: the Excel counts every event under one table so its totals compare; it keeps the platform's groups and SETUP.md §45 says so.

**The owner, 2026-10-24, the second question:** «how do we register the runners when they finish?» — and, told the site had no finish button, «Do it!!». Until now a finisher's time reached the site after the race, typed or imported from a sheet.

**Decision, the finish line.** A page of its own under «Clasament», **«Sosire»** (`/admin/events/[id]/results/sosire`, the one spelling in both locales like `mesaje`), for whoever enters results: one box, one button. The race number typed as the runner crosses, «Sosit» pressed, and the service (`recordFinish`) stamps **the time since the gun** — `race_starts_at`, else the event's start (`gunOf`), the same instant the checkpoints count from (§757) — to the second, as that runner's «Sosit», under the rules a line of «Clasament» already has: a race only, a number a **confirmed** registration holds, one row per registration, the whole list ranked again, one audit row (`event_result.created`, or `.updated` when a runner written off as «Abandon», «Neprezentat» or «Descalificat» by mistake crosses the line and becomes «Sosit» with the note kept), the public cache told. The page comes back with `?ok=<number>` and says who and what time from the stored row (never a name in the address), the box empty for the next runner, a clock since the gun ticking (`FinishClock`, the page's one island — a clock cannot be a Server Component; the press stamps the server's clock, never the browser's) and «Ultimii sosiți», the latest press first, so a stuck press is seen. Refused **in place**, the number kept in the box: a number no confirmed registration holds (`RESULT_BIB_UNKNOWN`, the sentence carrying the stamped time so the volunteer writes it down and the runner is typed later under «Alergători neînscriși»), a number already finished (`RESULT_ALREADY_FINISHED`, the stored time in the sentence: a correction is «Clasament»'s), a press before the gun (`RESULT_FINISH_NOT_STARTED`) and one more than a day after it (`RESULT_FINISH_CLOSED`: nobody crosses a line a day later, and the time would not fit the column). The action asks no confirmation: a finish line cannot ask before every runner, and a stamped time is one line of the results, corrected or deleted on «Clasament».

**Refused.** A finish button for every staff role: §808 gave results to the Organizer and the Administrators and BR-REQ-060-01 criterion 165 holds it; the desk Volunteer's line stays the paper sheet, and the owner may widen the role later as a rule change. Creating a nameless row for an unknown number: a typed runner needs a name (§808) and a name is not typed at a finish line; the time in the refusal is the compromise. Chip times, a second clock or a scanner: a club race has one line and one clock. Undo at the line: a wrong press is corrected on «Clasament», where the row is one of many and the delete asks.

**And the desk's scanner (the owner, 2026-10-25, from a QA rehearsal: «It works but the camera does not focus»).** `QrScanButton` asked the phone for any back camera and nothing more; on some Android phones that is a lens that holds one distance, so a code held close stayed a blur and was never read. The island now asks for a 1280×720 stream and, where the track says it can, continuous autofocus (`focusMode: "continuous"` through `applyConstraints`); where it cannot, nothing changes and the camera app stays the way, as the page already says. No library, as before (§318's rule: the browser's own `BarcodeDetector`).
changelogLine: - **A race chooses its own age categories, «Clasament» shows the podium, and «Sosire» stamps the finishers** — «Categorii de vârstă» on the results page takes the ages each group starts at («18, 35, 45, 55»), ranks the saved results again under them and says them on the event page, in the CSV and in the filter; «Premii» lists the podium for women, for men and in every category, as deep as the race awards (1–10, three by default) and with the categories or without them; and the new page «Sosire» under «Clasament» takes a race number as the runner crosses the line and stamps the time since the gun as their «Sosit», on a phone, no stopwatch; and the desk's «Scanează» asks the phone's camera to keep focusing, so a QR code held close is read. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given a race's «Clasament» page, when an Organizer or an Administrator writes the ages the age groups start at in «Categorii de vârstă» and presses «Salvează categoriile», then the list (one to twelve whole ages between 1 and 99, read in any order and sorted, an empty box meaning the platform's bands 18, 30, 40, 50, 60 stored as null) is saved on the event, every stored result is ranked again by category in the same transaction, one audit row records the ages and how many rows moved and never a runner, the public cache is told, a list that cannot be read is refused in place naming the problem with every box keeping what was typed, on an event that is not a race it is refused RESULTS_NOT_OPEN, and the Tehnic role, the Redactor, the desk Volunteer and a member are refused FORBIDDEN whatever the page drew (2026-10-24, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `results/age-bands.test.ts`, `results/ranking.test.ts`, integration `results/results.test.ts`, `results/actions.test.ts`, `results/page.test.ts`.

Given a race's saved results, when its «Clasament» page is drawn, then a card «Premii» lists, from the ranking's own positions and counting nothing again, the first three places by sex for women then for men and the first three in each of the race's categories youngest band first, each line the race number, the name as the backoffice sees it and the gun time, a tie on the same step and a group with nobody placed left out; and a category is said in words from the race's own bands — the same stored key reading «30-39 ani» under the platform's bands and «30-44 ani» where the next band starts at 45 — on that page, on the event page, in the CSV and on the filter's chips, which sort by the age a band starts at (2026-10-24, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `results/awards.test.ts`, `results/age-bands.test.ts`, `results/csv-and-words.test.ts`, integration `results/page.test.ts`, `results/results.test.ts`.

Given a race that has started within the last day, when an Organizer or an Administrator types a race number on «Sosire» and presses «Sosit», then the runner whose confirmed registration holds that number gets a «Sosit» result with the time since the gun (the race's own start when stated, else the event's start) to the second, a runner stored as «Abandon», «Neprezentat» or «Descalificat» becomes «Sosit» with the note kept, the whole list is ranked again, one audit row names the number and the times and never a name, the public cache is told, and the page comes back with the box empty saying who and what time and listing the latest finishers first; and a number no confirmed registration holds is refused in place with the stamped time in the sentence, a number already finished with the stored time, a press before the gun or more than a day after it is refused, a group run has no finish line, and the Tehnic role, the Redactor, the desk Volunteer and a member are refused FORBIDDEN (2026-10-25, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: integration `results/finish.test.ts`, `results/actions.test.ts`, `cms/boundary.test.ts`.

Given a race's «Premii» card, when an Organizer or an Administrator writes how many places are awarded (one to ten) and ticks or unticks «Premiezi și fiecare categorie» and presses «Salvează premiile», then the two are saved on the event (three and ticked by default) with one audit row carrying both values, a count outside one to ten is refused in place on its box, a group run is refused RESULTS_NOT_OPEN and the Tehnic role, the Redactor, the desk Volunteer and a member FORBIDDEN; and the card then lists that many places for women and for men and, only while the tick is on, in every category, the public page unchanged (2026-10-25, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `results/awards.test.ts`, integration `results/results.test.ts`, `results/actions.test.ts`, `results/page.test.ts`.

batchLine: a race's own age categories and the podium on «Clasament», and the finish line «Sosire»
